title: trisetum spicatum var. phleoides
intro: Trisetum spicatum var. phleoides, commonly known as Awnless Brome, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant is known for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. Awnless Brome exhibits therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of conditions like asthma and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of Trisetum spicatum var. phleoides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
